name: cbct-reading-v2
description: ReadX — macOS / Go + React + Electron；核心源码由 Windows 基准同步

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cbct/shared && npm run build -w @cbct/web && npm run build -w @cbct/desktop && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs && npm run package:mac -w @cbct/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cbct/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cbct/web && npm run typecheck -w @cbct/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test -w @cbct/shared && npm run test:latex && npm run test:books && npm run test:margin-notes && npm run test:processing && node --test scripts/research-workbench.test.cjs && npm run typecheck && npm run test -w @cbct/desktop && node --test scripts/browser-backup.test.cjs && node --test scripts/review-fixes.test.cjs && npm run test:external
scripts.test:backup: npm run build -w @cbct/shared && npm run build -w @cbct/desktop && node --experimental-sqlite --test apps/desktop/test/backup.test.cjs scripts/browser-backup.test.cjs
